heroHeadline: Day 92: DOJ Indicts Chinese Nationals for CJNG Money Laundering; Plan Kukulkan 17 Days; El Sapo Still at Large
heroSubtitle: Day 92 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). DOJ CHINESE NATIONALS INDICTMENT (May 23): U.S. DOJ charged two Chinese nationals — Ruhuan Zhen and Hongce Wu — for laundering drug proceeds for both CJNG and the Sinaloa Cartel via transnational Chinese underground banking networks. The dual-cartel scope confirms Chinese financial intermediaries operate across cartel lines, treating them as revenue clients — a persistent structural vulnerability in CJNG's financial architecture that the DOJ continues targeting post-Mencho. The indictment follows the El Jardinero superseding indictment (May 14), El Chipo financial network arrest (May 19), and the sustained Los Cuinis prosecution history. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 92: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target. His capture or elimination before June 11 is Mexico's stated primary objective for the final Plan Kukulkan phase. PLAN KUKULKAN — 17 DAYS: Seventeen days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). Mexico has deployed 100,000+ security personnel. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 matches) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. U.S. special forces confirmed training Mexican military on stadium attack prevention and drone bomb defense. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 16: Sixteen days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9), no successor named. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 92): Ongoing — Mullin-Sheinbaum 'coordination without subordination' framework active; June bilateral meeting scheduled. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
